item: Team advanced statistics are a 2026-11-14 snapshot; the live table now reflects later games.
why: Re-reading the official team advanced table on 2026-11-14 shows 16 of 30 teams with more games played than the captured snapshot (e.g. San Antonio 13 GP live vs 12 captured; Golden State 13 vs 12; Oklahoma City 13 vs 12). Values were correct at capture time and are left unchanged per the never-infer policy; no always-current feed exists in this static Pages site.
action_needed: Re-capture the team advanced table before publishing a new slate, model run or originated line; treat stored values as a dated snapshot.

item: The official injury index now lists 11/14 reports newer than the 11/13 07:45 PM ET report used.
why: The official injury index (re-read 2026-11-14) lists 11/14 reports from 12:00 a.m. to 4:15 a.m. ET, newer than the 11/13 07:45 PM ET snapshot used for the injury table. No stored row changed and no pick or line change is indicated; the newer reports were not transcribed.
action_needed: Re-read the newest report before publishing picks for a new slate and mark any snapshot older than the latest report as potentially stale.

item: No licensed odds feed is connected; all prices and ROI are the project's own originated fair prices against its own line.
why: Every ROI figure is measured against the project's own originated line at an assumed -110 price. Expected value is zero by construction; nothing here is an economic result, a positive-EV signal, or a bet.
action_needed: Connect a licensed, timestamped price feed before any ROI or EV figure is used for a decision, or stop publishing ROI.
